text: {"lessons":["My early decisions to hold through fluctuating account values reinforced that short-term moves are not reliable forecasts in a random market.","Selling some Stock B and E at gains felt satisfying, but I should not sell winners merely to lock in profits; evaluate each holding against my plan and portfolio risk.","Buying A, C, and D after trimming B and E changed my allocation, so I should check diversification and position sizes while resisting both loss aversion and the urge to trade frequently."]}
